textBox.richText: Today is a very special day because today I am finally upgrading website designs. This is a day that I had been preparing for this week and I can’t wait to explain how this happened. The template for this website comes from the official iWeb app that’s installed on my iMac. I went with a pre-made template because it’s easier and it’s also really cool looking. I don’t think I want to create at the moment multiple entries to back up my old entries so for now I’m going to just leave a copy of my old code for the blog page in case anyone wants to read the ramblings of a teenager. I don’t know why you’d want to but the entries will still be there in case you care. Anyways, I’m excited about posting on this more modern web design. I don’t have much to say on it so I apologize if your expectations for this entry were higher but not much has happened today which is why I can’t comment on my day. I’m about to head out for the evening which is also why this entry is short because I have to download a backup of my old website design and use GitHub Desktop for the first time in 2-3 years to commit my website changes with the proper file layout in the least amount of time possible. To whoever reads this I hope you have a great evening and sweet dreams. I will try to see you all tomorrow. Goodbye!
